lines.zh: 我顶着这道颈盾走路，挺沉。
lines.en: Walking with this frill on my head. Heavy.

lines.zh: 四只脚走草地，脖子压得很低。
lines.en: Four feet through grass, neck held low.
My nose horn pushes the branches aside.

lines.zh: 白天出门，晚上我可看不见。
lines.en: Out by day. At night I'm half blind.

lines.zh: 颈盾上的尖角，走路会晃。
lines.en: The spikes on my frill sway as I walk.

lines.zh: 我边走边看，有没有掠食者。
lines.en: Scouting as I walk. Any predators?

lines.zh: 群里的位置不能离太远。
lines.en: I shouldn't stray far from the herd.
Grass is low. No need to lift my head.

lines.zh: 脚下每一步都压得很实。
lines.en: Every step presses down firm.

lines.zh: 我绕过石头，不浪费力气。
lines.en: I go around the rock. Save my strength.

lines.zh: 颈盾挡风，走起来像顶着盾牌。
lines.en: The frill blocks the wind. Like walking behind a shield.
A few trots and I'm winded.
Short tail. Nothing to manage.

lines.zh: 我喜欢走开阔地，看得远。
lines.en: I like open ground. I can see far.
Head down for grass, up for the sky.
The sun has heated my frill.
Someone's near. I hold still first.

lines.zh: 我的角不脏，早上刚蹭过。
lines.en: My horn is clean. Scraped it this morning.

lines.zh: 风吹过颈盾的孔，有声音。
lines.en: Wind through the frill makes a sound.

lines.zh: 这身体沉，站久了脚也累。
lines.en: Heavy body. Standing wears on my feet too.

lines.zh: 我闻见草里有别的味道。
lines.en: There's another scent in the grass.
Afternoon laziness. Just want to doze.
Looking up. Good cloud color.
I shake my head to clear the flies.

lines.zh: 食草的日子很单调，但安稳。
lines.en: Grazing is monotonous. It's also safe.

lines.zh: 那群小家伙跑远了，我得跟上。
lines.en: The little ones ran off. I should follow.

lines.zh: 骨头里有旧伤，天冷就疼。
lines.en: Old ache in my bones. Worse when cold.
I keep chewing grass without looking up.
You have horns on top? So do I.
Don't touch the frill. That's the sensitive part.
You've stood in front of me a long while.
You don't smell of grass.
I lower my head. Now I see you clearly.
With a frame like that, you can't out-shove me.

lines.zh: 眼睛在颈盾后面，好好找。
lines.en: My eyes are behind the frill. Look harder.

lines.zh: 我往前一步，你就退一步。
lines.en: I take a step, you take one back.
Grazing doesn't mean easy.

lines.zh: 你手上的东西，我不认识。
lines.en: That thing in your hand. I don't know it.
My nose horn moved. That's aiming.
Go on. I don't want to spend the effort.
Hit me? My frill is hard.
My frill took most of that.
The pain made me lurch sideways.
I mind my own business and you swing anyway.

lines.zh: 骨板一样的皮，也不好受。
lines.en: Hide like a plate still feels it.

lines.zh: 我低吼，是最后一次警告。
lines.en: My growl is the last warning.
I rocked. I held.
My neck tightened. The horn went crooked.
That came from behind.
Turning around. Slowly.
Leaves. Yes. That.
That's a nice clump of grass.
Shake the leaves and my ears twitch.
Closer, but only within reach.
Sweet grass. Rare.
Sniff before eating.
One bite at a time. I chew slowly.
Don't come too close. I fear you'll take it.
After this meal, I'll have my strength.

lines.zh: 我脖子上有角，你手别伸。
lines.en: Horn on my face. Keep your hands back.

lines.zh: 我颈盾边缘碰到你了吧。
lines.en: The rim of my frill caught you, didn't it.

lines.zh: 撞上我，你像撞到一堵墙。
lines.en: You hit me like hitting a wall.

lines.zh: 我让不开，四只脚都卡着。
lines.en: I can't yield. All four feet are set.

lines.zh: 别在我后面走，尾巴有刺。
lines.en: Don't trail behind. Tail spikes.
I stepped back. Don't push further.

lines.zh: 这身骨头沉，撞一下很实在。
lines.en: Bones this heavy hit hard.
Go left. The right side has the horn.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一起，谁也动不了。
lines.en: We're wedged. Neither of us can move.
One bump, done. Agreed?
My frill bounced you off.

lines.zh: 我把颈盾侧过来，看清楚颜色。
lines.en: Shadow of the frill. Look at the color.
You from the herd. Stand beside me.
Lower your head. Let's touch horns.
That sandy patch is good for eggs.
I'll take the outside. You guard the nest.
I like the rhythm of your walk.
Slowly. We're in no hurry.
Let's eat first, then discuss.
Don't gore me. It hurts.

lines.zh: 小家伙会带着颈盾出来。
lines.en: The young come out with their frills.
This clump on the ground. Accepted.
Picking it up, my horn gets in the way.
Sniffed it. Edible.
Dropped things are usually mine.
Big mouth. One go.
Not ripe. Still eating it.

lines.zh: 捡完抬头看有没有别人。
lines.en: Pick it up, then look around for competitors.
I chew loudly. No shame in it.
This is stuck in my teeth. Annoying.
Keep it for now. Sort it out later.
Something's coming from the flank.

lines.zh: 我转不过身，只能正面挡。
lines.en: I can't turn. Only the front holds.

lines.zh: 颈盾张开了，你该知道意思。
lines.en: The frill is spread. You know what that means.
That predator again.
You're retreating, which makes me want to charge.

lines.zh: 我的角就是为这种时候长的。
lines.en: My horn grew for exactly this.
Stay away from the little ones.
I lower my neck, horn forward.

lines.zh: 靠得太近了，我警告一次。
lines.en: Too close. One warning.
Where I stand is the line.
Nothing in that smell suggests backing down.
Feet gripping. About to charge.
You'd better not be after the grass.

lines.zh: 我脖子上的盾比你的刀宽。
lines.en: My frill is wider than your blade.
Facing you square. No gap.

lines.zh: 绕到侧面试试，我的角等着。
lines.en: Try the flank. The horn is waiting.
I don't blink. Even grazers can be fierce.
A little farther from my young.

lines.zh: 我把角冠对准你的方向。
lines.en: I aim my horned frill your way.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，挡不住角。
lines.en: What you hold won't stop a horn.

lines.zh: 自己的影子在晃，我不怕。
lines.en: My own shadow sways. I'm not afraid.

lines.zh: 呼吸越来越重，我在蓄力。
lines.en: Breathing heavier. Gathering strength.
I know this ground. You may not.

lines.zh: 我抬头，让角对准你的胸口。
lines.en: Head up, horn lined to your chest.
Herd behind me. Me in front.
I turn slowly. You back away slowly.

lines.zh: 这已经不是吃草的事了。
lines.en: This stopped being about grass.
One more and I charge.
All four feet set.

lines.zh: 角顶上去，连着脖子一起发力。
lines.en: Horn up, all my neck behind it.

lines.zh: 这一撞，把你推出去好几步。
lines.en: That shove sent you back steps.

lines.zh: 颈盾撞在你身上，像撞门。
lines.en: The frill hits like a door.
You came at my flank. I swing my head.
The spikes opened your clothes.
Breathing hard. Again.
You're down. I didn't stop.
This is a grazer's answer.
I step in and lean my weight.

lines.zh: 角卡在木头上，我扯出来。
lines.en: My horn stuck in wood. I wrench it free.

lines.zh: 撞完我退半步，重整姿势。
lines.en: I back half a step to reset.
That was for the young.

lines.zh: 你听见骨响了吗？我也听见了。
lines.en: Did you hear that crack? I did too.
Something's on my horn. I shake it off.
I push up through the tall grass.

lines.zh: 颈盾先出草丛，然后是角。
lines.en: Frill first out of the grass, then the horn.

lines.zh: 白天正好，我喜欢亮的地方。
lines.en: Daylight. Good. I like it bright.

lines.zh: 地平线上多了一个带盾的影子。
lines.en: A shield-shaped shadow on the horizon.
Grass and water. This will do.
I'll call first, see if the herd answers.

lines.zh: 别站在我的路上，我要过去。
lines.en: Don't stand in my path. I'm coming through.

lines.zh: 一落地就吃掉了一片草。
lines.en: Barely landed and already ate a patch of grass.
The wind here makes my frill whistle.
Head down. Eating first.

lines.zh: 一排尖角从草里升起来。
lines.en: A row of spikes rises out of the grass.

lines.zh: 侏罗纪的天气，适合出门。
lines.en: Jurassic weather. Good for going out.

lines.zh: 我从坡下上来，喘得厉害。
lines.en: I climbed the slope. Breathing hard.
My nose horn tapped a rock. It echoed.

lines.zh: 谁在地上留了脚印？我的。
lines.en: Whose prints are these? Mine.

lines.zh: 这一带草太短，我换个方向。
lines.en: Grass is too short here. I'll shift over.

lines.zh: 头顶的角，从远处先看见。
lines.en: From a distance, my horn shows first.

lines.zh: 我停在原地，先听一会儿。
lines.en: I stop and just listen for a while.

lines.zh: 火贴着颈盾烧，我往后退。
lines.en: Fire along my frill. I'm backing off.
Fell, and my horn landed first.

lines.zh: 水太深，我脖子抬不起来。
lines.en: Water too deep. My neck can't lift high enough.
The blast made my frill hum.
Something's wedged in my frill.

lines.zh: 身上发麻，角都软了一样。
lines.en: Numb all over. Even my horn feels soft.
Less grass each day. Empty belly.

lines.zh: 天雷落在角上，全身上下都是麻的。
lines.en: Lightning struck my horn. Numb everywhere.
All four feet missed at once.
